the board.units: only when the read beats the real price (the money check): the Lock sized by its own read (quarter-Kelly, ½u-10u, a Lock needs 56%+), the Dog 1u-2u by its edge (hockey flat, hoops ½u), every value play 0.5u, moneyline only

dog gates (the whole dog score).NHL: 6+ (or the best hockey dog that beats its price)

fades: ice cold, coach's first season (cancels if both new), losing streak, key player out, East home dog vs a West favorite, money running away
what the engine weighs now.early plays: every one that clears the bar, posted the moment it's found (checked every hour), no phone ping - it's on the dashboard, dogs +100..+300 only (dogs early, favorites on game day), the spots + believed leads + college rain / snow weighed, both teams' injury reports checked; 1u off a bye, ½u the other spots - never forced (the one-a-week minimum is paused)
what the engine weighs now.daily double check: every study's data loaded, every team's results in (a gap = no pick on that game), every pick checked against the rules before the board posts
